title: Preußenstadion - Wikipedia
content: # Preußenstadion. | Map Interactive map of LVM-Preußenstadion | |. **Preußenstadion**, currently known as **LVM-Preußenstadion** for sponsorship reasons, is a multi-use stadium in Münster, Germany. It is used as the stadium of Preußen Münster matches. The capacity of the stadium is 14,300 spectators.
